say:6:1620128006:1.text: Let me see... Add <style="highlight">calmgrass</style>, <style="highlight">violet veilleaves</style>, and <style="highlight">honeyfruits</style>, then simmer the mixture until everything melts. Finally, apply it to the surface of the spirit...

say:7:1620128007:1.text: Oh? Why include honeyfruit? Does it have a calming effect as well?
say:7:1620128007:1.source_cn: 咦，为什么要加蜜果？难道是有什么特别的疗效，比如……唔...

say:8:1620128008:2.text: I only put it there for personal reasons.
say:8:1620128008:2.source_cn: 不用猜了，它没有任何疗效。这只是我个人的一点私心。

say:9:1620128009:1.text: Rocky loved honeyfruit, but I was careful not to let it have too much, since cats are carnivores.
say:9:1620128009:1.source_cn: 小石头很喜欢吃蜜果，但因为猫是肉食动物，我一直不让它多吃。

say:10:1620128010:1.text: Now that it has become a spirit, I suppose it can eat whatever it likes.
say:10:1620128010:1.source_cn: 现在它已经变成猫灵了，也不在乎这些了。我就想让它能吃点...

say:11:1620128011:1.text: We give children candy to coax them into taking medicine, don't we? This is the same idea.
say:11:1620128011:1.source_cn: 给孩子吃药的时候，也总要塞块糖，哄孩子开心一点的。

say:12:1620128012:0.text: We can get violet veilleaves and calmgrass at the market. As for fresh honeyfruit... hmm, I don't think there are any fruit stalls nearby. We'll probably need to pick some from the forest.
say:12:1620128012:0.source_cn: 安宁紫叶和宁神草在商业街就能买到，至于新鲜的蜜果……唔...

say:15:1620128013:1.text: I'll head to the market. Haggling is kind of my thing.
say:15:1620128013:1.source_cn: 我去商业街买东西吧，我在砍价方面上还是颇有心得的。

say:16:1620128014:1.text: Magister, let's see if there are any <style="highlight">fresh honeyfruits</style> in the <style="highlight">forest</style>!
say:16:1620128014:1.male: Magister, let's see if there are any <style="highlight">fresh honeyfruits</style> in the <style="highlight">forest</style>!
say:16:1620128014:1.female: Magister, let's see if there are any <style="highlight">fresh honeyfruits</style> in the <style="highlight">forest</style>!

say:0:1620129001:0.text: Magister, there's a forest nearby! Let's see if we can find some honeyfruits there!
say:0:1620129001:0.source_cn: 主人，附近就有一片森林，我们去那里找一些新鲜的蜜果吧！
say:0:1620129001:0.male: Magister, there's a forest nearby! Let's see if we can find some honeyfruits there!
say:0:1620129001:0.female: Magister, there's a forest nearby! Let's see if we can find some honeyfruits there!

say:0:1620130001:0.text: Huff... I think we've got enough. Magister, let's head back and start preparing the potion!
say:0:1620130001:0.source_cn: 呼……这么多应该足够了。主人，我们回去找教授炼制药剂吧！
say:0:1620130001:0.male: Huff... I think we've got enough. Magister, let's head back and start preparing the potion!
say:0:1620130001:0.female: Huff... I think we've got enough. Magister, let's head back and start preparing the potion!

say:1:1620131001:1.text: Professor, we have some honeyfruits here! Is Witstaff back already?
say:1:1620131001:1.source_cn: 教授，我们已经采到蜜果啦！维茨瓦夫回来了吗？

say:4:1620131002:1.text: Here! I've bought the ingredients we need as well as a crucible.
say:4:1620131002:1.source_cn: 在呢在呢，需要的材料和坩埚我都买回来了。

say:7:1620131003:1.text: Great, now we're ready to get to work. Who's up for it?
say:7:1620131003:1.source_cn: 很好，这样材料就齐了，随时可以开始炼制。你们谁来？

say:9:1620131004:1.text: I think... I'm not ready yet.

say:10:1620131005:1.text: As much as I want to try my hand at alchemy, it's safer to leave this one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1620131005:1.source_cn: 毕竟是很重要的药剂，虽然我很想试试炼金……但是，这次还...
say:10:1620131005:1.male: As much as I want to try my hand at alchemy, it's safer to leave this one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1620131005:1.female: As much as I want to try my hand at alchemy, it's safer to leave this one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:11:1620131006:1.text: Good. You've got a clear sense of your own limits.
say:11:1620131006:1.source_cn: 嗯，你对自己能力的认知还算清楚。

say:12:1620131007:1.text: Professor, I'm not immune to your blunt criticisms...
say:12:1620131007:1.source_cn: 教授，听见这么直接的评价，我还是会有点伤心的……

say:15:1620131008:0.text: Professor, you can trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He's the best mage around!
say:15:1620131008:0.male: Professor, you can trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He's the best mage around!
say:15:1620131008:0.female: Professor, you can trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>! She's the best mage around!

say:0:1620132001:0.text: You nailed it, Magister! Now, we just need to wait for Rocky to show up tonight.
say:0:1620132001:0.source_cn: 成功了，不愧是主人！现在就等晚上，小石头再次出现了。
say:0:1620132001:0.male: You nailed it, Magister! Now, we just need to wait for Rocky to show up tonight.
say:0:1620132001:0.female: You nailed it, Magister! Now, we just need to wait for Rocky to show up tonight.

say:1:1620134002:0.source_cn: 先去找亚娜奇卡教授商量一下吧。

say:1:1620135001:1.text: Professor, don't worry! We'll figure out another way!
say:1:1620135001:1.source_cn: 教授，你别着急，我们一定能找到解决办法的！

say:2:1620135002:1.text: By the way, is Rocky scared of you? Why does it take off the moment it sees you?
say:2:1620135002:1.source_cn: 不过，小石头很害怕你吗？为什么一看见你，它就要跑走呢？

say:3:1620135003:1.text: Take off? No, Rocky's still here. We just can't see it.
say:3:1620135003:1.source_cn: 跑走？不，小石头没有走，它就在这里。只不过，我们看不见它。

say:4:1620135004:1.text: The potion didn't work, which tells me one thing—Rocky didn't run away; its spirit is <style="highlight">scattered</style> and can't take form.
say:4:1620135004:1.source_cn: 药剂没有用，更验证了我的猜测。小石头不是逃走而消失，而...

say:6:1620135006:1.text: In other words, Rocky's spirit is too fragile. When it's around stronger spirits, it loses its shape and appears to have vanished.
say:6:1620135006:1.source_cn: 简单来说，它的灵体被磨损得太厉害了。就像一缕烟，当旁边...

say:7:1620135007:1.text: That's why Rocky only appears at night and can't interact with other cats.
say:7:1620135007:1.source_cn: 这也是为什么小石头只能在晚上出现，也无法和其他猫交谈的原因。

say:8:1620135008:1.text: Its spirit is extremely weak... almost to the point of losing its form.
say:8:1620135008:1.source_cn: 它的灵体非常微弱……已经接近无法显形的程度了。

say:9:1620135009:2.text: Rocky... What exactly have you been through?
say:9:1620135009:2.source_cn: 小石头……你到底经历了什么？

say:12:1620135010:1.text: It's not the end of the world yet! Can't we just use spirit-enhancing magic on Rocky?
say:12:1620135010:1.source_cn: 等等，先别伤心！事情也不是没有解决的方法嘛，既然小石头...

say:13:1620135011:1.text: Leave it to me! This is what I do best!
say:13:1620135011:1.source_cn: 这件事就交给我吧，我最擅长这个了！

say:14:1620135012:2.text: Wait, don't be rash! Put your wand away first, Witstaff!
say:14:1620135012:2.source_cn: 等等，等等！别冲动——维茨瓦夫先生，请先把魔杖收起来！

say:15:1620135013:1.text: Spirit-enhancing... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you perform spirit-summoning magic?
say:15:1620135013:1.male: Spirit-enhancing... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you perform spirit-summoning magic?
say:15:1620135013:1.female: Spirit-enhancing... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you perform spirit-summoning magic?

say:16:1620135014:1.text: If we can summon all fragments of Rocky's spirit, we can merge them back with spirit concentration magic.
say:16:1620135014:1.source_cn: 将小石头的灵体呼唤出来，再通过聚灵魔法将其聚合。

say:17:1620135015:1.text: Aha! It's like piecing a puzzle!
say:17:1620135015:1.source_cn: 我明白了！把碎片重新拼起来，就能补全小石头的灵体。

choice_prompt:18:1620135015.text: Aha! It's like piecing a puzzle!
choice_prompt:18:1620135015.source_cn: 我明白了！把碎片重新拼起来，就能补全小石头的灵体。

say:19:1620135016:1.text: Thank you. Since I can no longer cast magic, I'm counting on you to help Rocky.
say:19:1620135016:1.source_cn: 谢谢。我已经无法使用魔法，小石头的事就拜托你了。

say:20:1620135017:1.text: Hmm...Rocky could get even rowdier with a stable spirit.
say:20:1620135017:1.source_cn: 唔……只是，如果小石头有了稳定的灵体后，可能就会更吵了。

say:21:1620135018:1.text: And that means no more peaceful nights for you, Professor. Are you alright with that?
say:21:1620135018:1.source_cn: 教授，这意味着你可能再也没法安眠了，没关系吗？

say:22:1620135019:1.text: I'm dead, remember? I don't need sleep anymore.
say:22:1620135019:1.source_cn: 睡觉？反正我都死了，睡不睡都一样，难道不是小石头的健康...

say:23:1620135020:1.text: Plus, I actually feel reassured when Rocky gets noisy. It means it's doing well.
say:23:1620135020:1.source_cn: 不如说它变吵了我才放心。吵说明有精力闹腾，说明它恢复了健康。

say:24:1620135021:1.text: So, don't worry about me. Nothing matters more to me than Rocky's well-being.
say:24:1620135021:1.source_cn: 你们不用多想，只要小石头能好好的就行，其他的都无所谓。

say:25:1620135022:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'd appreciate it if you could help Rocky with magic.
say:25:1620135022:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'd appreciate it if you could help Rocky with magic.
say:25:1620135022:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'd appreciate it if you could help Rocky with magic.

narration:26:1620135023:0.text: Anathyme fades from sight. Several seconds later, a faint wisp of mist drifts past the spot where Rocky has just disappeared...
narration:26:1620135023:0.source_cn: 亚娜奇卡隐去了身形。几个呼吸后，就在小石头刚刚消失的原...

narration:27:1620135024:0.text: The cat spirit emerges again, circling the spot in confusion. Then, it heads toward Anathyme's tombstone with practiced ease, as if it's done this a hundred times.
narration:27:1620135024:0.source_cn: 小猫灵再次出现，茫然地原地绕了个圈后，便又熟门熟路地走...

choice:18:0:1.text: I can give it a try.
choice:18:0:1.male: I can give it a try.
choice:18:0:1.female: I can give it a try.

say:0:1620137001:0.text: It's meowing! Looks like Rocky's spirit is stable now! Shall we chat with it through transfiguration?
say:0:1620137001:0.source_cn: 小石头的灵体稳固后，已经能够发出声音啦！或许，可以用变...

say:1:1620137002:0.text: Is Rocky excited to see Professor Anathyme? *Sobbing* Chippy's heart can't handle this!
say:1:1620137002:0.source_cn: 它一直在喵喵叫个不停，是不是因为见到教授很激动？呜呜…...

say:1:1620138002:0.text: Wow! That human's turned into a wolf!
say:1:1620138002:0.male: Wow! That human's turned into a wolf!
say:1:1620138002:0.female: Wow! That human's turned into a wolf!

say:1:1620139001:1.text: Wow, did you just turn into a wolf? Are you a mage too, like the professor?
say:1:1620139001:1.source_cn: 人……真的变成狼了！你也是和主人一样的魔法师吧！
say:1:1620139001:1.male: Wow, did you just turn into a wolf? Are you a mage too, like the professor?
say:1:1620139001:1.female: Wow, did you just turn into a wolf? Are you a mage too, like the professor?

say:2:1620139002:1.text: Your magic's incredible! I was in pain everywhere before, but now I feel great!
say:2:1620139002:1.source_cn: 你的魔法真厉害。之前我到处都好疼，但现在我觉得好多了，...
say:2:1620139002:1.male: Your magic's incredible! I was in pain everywhere before, but now I feel great!
say:2:1620139002:1.female: Your magic's incredible! I was in pain everywhere before, but now I feel great!

say:3:1620139003:1.text: Most importantly, I can see the professor now. It took me ages to find her! Thanks for your help!
say:3:1620139003:1.source_cn: 而且，我现在能看见主人了！我找了好久，终于找到她了。谢...
say:3:1620139003:1.male: Most importantly, I can see the professor now. It took me ages to find her! Thanks for your help!
say:3:1620139003:1.female: Most importantly, I can see the professor now. It took me ages to find her! Thanks for your help!

choice_prompt:4:1620139003.text: Most importantly, I can see the professor now. It took me ages to find her! Thanks for your help!
choice_prompt:4:1620139003.source_cn: 而且，我现在能看见主人了！我找了好久，终于找到她了。谢谢你帮了我！
choice_prompt:4:1620139003.male: Most importantly, I can see the professor now. It took me ages to find her! Thanks for your help!
choice_prompt:4:1620139003.female: Most importantly, I can see the professor now. It took me ages to find her! Thanks for your help!

say:5:1620139004:1.text: Professor Anathyme gave me away, and I followed my new owner to the Dark Forest.
say:5:1620139004:1.source_cn: 嗯，主人把我送给了其他的人，我们一起去了薄暮丛林。
say:5:1620139004:1.male: Professor Anathyme gave me away, and I followed my new owner to the Dark Forest.
say:5:1620139004:1.female: Professor Anathyme gave me away, and I followed my new owner to the Dark Forest.

say:6:1620139005:1.text: It was a breathtaking place, and my new owner treated me well. Even so, I wanted to be with the professor.
say:6:1620139005:1.source_cn: 那是个很美的地方，姐姐对我也很好。但我还是想主人。
say:6:1620139005:1.male: It was a breathtaking place, and my new owner treated me well. Even so, I wanted to be with the professor.
say:6:1620139005:1.female: It was a breathtaking place, and my new owner treated me well. Even so, I wanted to be with the professor.

say:7:1620139006:1.text: One day, I died, but my spirit lingered. Free to travel far and wide, I decided to come back and look for the professor.
say:7:1620139006:1.source_cn: 有一天我死了，但是我没有消失，变成了能走很远的灵体！我...
say:7:1620139006:1.male: One day, I died, but my spirit lingered. Free to travel far and wide, I decided to come back and look for the professor.
say:7:1620139006:1.female: One day, I died, but my spirit lingered. Free to travel far and wide, I decided to come back and look for the professor.

say:8:1620139007:1.text: The journey was long, but I met many kind spirits along the way. They pointed me in the right direction and even taught me spirit-binding.
say:8:1620139007:1.source_cn: 路很远，但我遇到了很多好心的灵体。大家帮我指路，还教我...
say:8:1620139007:1.male: The journey was long, but I met many kind spirits along the way. They pointed me in the right direction and even taught me spirit-binding.
say:8:1620139007:1.female: The journey was long, but I met many kind spirits along the way. They pointed me in the right direction and even taught me spirit-binding.

say:9:1620139008:1.text: I turned into the wheels of a carriage, the nets of a fishing boat, the fruit carried by birds, seeds drifting through the air…
say:9:1620139008:1.source_cn: 我变成了马车的轮子、轮船的渔网，鸟抓着的果实，四处飞的...
say:9:1620139008:1.male: I turned into the wheels of a carriage, the nets of a fishing boat, the fruit carried by birds, seeds drifting through the air…
say:9:1620139008:1.female: I turned into the wheels of a carriage, the nets of a fishing boat, the fruit carried by birds, seeds drifting through the air…

say:10:1620139009:1.text: By the time I reached the school, the place I grew up, the professor was no longer there.
say:10:1620139009:1.source_cn: 可等我找回学校，回到我长大的地方，主人已经不在那里了。
say:10:1620139009:1.male: By the time I reached the school, the place I grew up, the professor was no longer there.
say:10:1620139009:1.female: By the time I reached the school, the place I grew up, the professor was no longer there.

say:11:1620139010:1.text: I followed her scent for a long time, and it finally led me to this graveyard. That's when I realized she had passed away, just like me.
say:11:1620139010:1.source_cn: 我顺着主人的味道找了很久，最后来到了墓园。我才知道，原...

choice_prompt:12:1620139010.text: I followed her scent for a long time, and it finally led me to this graveyard. That's when I realized she had passed away, just like me.

choice_prompt:12:1620139010.male: I followed her scent for a long time, and it finally led me to this graveyard. That's when I realized she had passed away, just like me.
choice_prompt:12:1620139010.female: I followed her scent for a long time, and it finally led me to this graveyard. That's when I realized she had passed away, just like me.

say:13:1620139011:1.text: I found the professor's grave one day! I knew she was here somewhere, but I just couldn't see her.
say:13:1620139011:1.source_cn: 我找到了主人的墓，她就在这里！可我怎么也见不到她。
say:13:1620139011:1.male: I found the professor's grave one day! I knew she was here somewhere, but I just couldn't see her.
say:13:1620139011:1.female: I found the professor's grave one day! I knew she was here somewhere, but I just couldn't see her.

say:14:1620139012:1.text: I got anxious, and whenever that happens, I can't help but jump around.
say:14:1620139012:1.source_cn: 我很着急，一着急就想到处跳。
say:14:1620139012:1.male: I got anxious, and whenever that happens, I can't help but jump around.
say:14:1620139012:1.female: I got anxious, and whenever that happens, I can't help but jump around.

say:15:1620139013:1.text: Back then, whenever I climbed all over her while she was sleeping, she would sit up and pat my head.
say:15:1620139013:1.source_cn: 而且，以前主人睡觉的时候，我跳到她身上，她就会坐起来摸...
say:15:1620139013:1.male: Back then, whenever I climbed all over her while she was sleeping, she would sit up and pat my head.
say:15:1620139013:1.female: Back then, whenever I climbed all over her while she was sleeping, she would sit up and pat my head.

say:16:1620139014:1.text: So, I thought I could make her wake up by jumping longer.
say:16:1620139014:1.source_cn: 我想，说不定我跳久一点，主人就又醒过来啦。
say:16:1620139014:1.male: So, I thought I could make her wake up by jumping longer.
say:16:1620139014:1.female: So, I thought I could make her wake up by jumping longer.

say:17:1620139015:1.text: And it worked! She really appeared from the grave!
say:17:1620139015:1.source_cn: 果然，主人醒了，我又见到她了！
say:17:1620139015:1.male: And it worked! She really appeared from the grave!
say:17:1620139015:1.female: And it worked! She really appeared from the grave!

choice:12:0:1.text: Why have you been jumping around?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 你为什么要在墓园乱跳呢？
choice:12:0:1.male: Why have you been jumping around?
choice:12:0:1.female: Why have you been jumping around?

choice:4:0:1.text: Why aren't you in the Dark Forest?
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 你不是被送去薄暮丛林了吗
choice:4:0:1.male: Why aren't you in the Dark Forest?
choice:4:0:1.female: Why aren't you in the Dark Forest?

choice:4:1:2.male: Why did you come back here?
choice:4:1:2.female: Why did you come back here?
